prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 83.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 87.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 83.6%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.7%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 32.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Placement Readiness Screen: Insert a dedicated desktop verification screen right before waiting to confirm tray icon readiness and display system settings tips. (why: Support receives multiple complaints about pets failing to appear on the desktop or the app stalling, while the waiting step takes mean 2336s.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Certificate Account Sync Order: Move sign-in step immediately after adoption certificate finalization so account registration binds directly to the customized pet. (why: 8 support emails report pets missing or resetting upon re-signing in; binding the account right after customization prevents lost pet data.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Control Sandbox Flow: Rebuild home_intro into an interactive controls sandbox where users practice hiding, showing, and interacting with their desktop pet. (why: Support receives multiple tickets asking how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing Pet Sync Safeguard Hint: Add an explicit safeguard hint on sign_in explaining that existing pets and progress automatically restore upon logging in. (why: 8 support emails report missing pets or resets after sign in; clear copy reassures returning users.)
4: [home, wait_info] Spawning Status & Tray Indicator: Show an estimated waiting timer alongside a system tray notification indicator during pet rendering. (why: Home waiting median is 201s (mean 2336s) and users complain about pets not appearing on the desktop.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Centered Focus Layout for Path Selection: Switch choose_path screen layout to centered with clear path option cards for pre-made vs custom pets. (why: Choose path median is 8s but mean is 514s, indicating some users hesitate; centered layout focuses immediate decision making.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification Prompt: Enable readiness notification toggle on home_intro so desktop alerts pop up the instant the pet arrives on screen. (why: Finish step drop-off is 71.7% and mean completion time is high; OS notification alerts users when pet is ready.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Instant Desktop Companion Value Copy: Rewrite story headline and body to emphasize fast setup and instant interactive desktop companions. (why: Mean time spent in early onboarding steps is long (514s); clear initial value copy encourages faster progression.)
